title: Reflexive pencil descent removes global free frames on a plane target

newly_used_primary_inputs.exact_import: Stacks Lemma 31.13.15, tag 0B3N: on a regular scheme of dimension at most two a coherent module is reflexive if and only if it is finite locally free.
newly_used_primary_inputs.role: Make the finite reflexive rank-two pencil lattice locally free on Spec C[T,V]. The nowhere-zero constant section then has invertible quotient.
newly_used_primary_inputs.portions_inspected: Complete lemma statement and proof on the primary tag page; hypotheses checked in the canonical proof.

newly_used_primary_inputs.exact_import: Stacks Lemma 10.128.1, tag 00R4: a local map of Noetherian local rings is flat when the source is regular, the target is Cohen-Macaulay and the target dimension is the source dimension plus the closed-fibre dimension.
newly_used_primary_inputs.role: Prove flatness of the ambient suspension observable map at height-two target points from its regular sequence and expected dimension. Nonempty closed fibres give faithfulness separately.
newly_used_primary_inputs.portions_inspected: Complete lemma statement and proof on the primary tag page; hypotheses checked in the canonical proof.

direct_proof_arguments: faithful flatness and integral generic height-one fibres make every target prime pull back to a prime divisor with the same scalar valuation
one relative derivation bounds all coefficients of the rank-two pencil lattice inside a fixed finite free fractional lattice
normality identifies the lattice with the intersection of its height-one localizations, proving reflexivity by the double-dual criterion
the constant section is nowhere zero by faithful flatness, its quotient is invertible and the factorial target trivializes it
the resulting primitive coordinate is transcendental on every geometric generic height-one fibre and gives global polynomial saturation
the generic component-pencil proof needs only a generic filtration; saturation and the smooth unit derivative close the carried Keller pair
all disjoint moving multipliers satisfying the exact content-level criterion are faithfully flat and have the needed generic filtration and zero source-fixed classes
